name: studio-clean
description: Example global design system. Copy to design/global.json and make it yours. Every job in the collection is resolved against it; per-product files (assets/<job>/design.json) can override anything not listed in `locked`.

style.theme: Quiet, premium, editorial. Honest product photography with generous negative space.

palette.notes: Warm neutrals. The subject's own colours are never shifted to fit the palette.

style.lighting: Large soft key light from camera left, gentle fill, no hard specular hotspots.
style.shadows: Soft contact shadow directly under the subject; no long cast shadows.
style.photographic_style: Clean catalogue realism, true colours, shallow grade.
style.composition: Subject centred or on a third, fully in frame, at least 12% margin on every side.
style.camera: Eye-level three-quarter view, 50-85 mm look, f/5.6, everything on the subject sharp.
style.product_positioning: Upright, front face readable, sitting naturally on the surface.
style.props: None unless a mockup asks for them; never more than two.
style.branding: No added logos or text in generated images; branding is composited with overlays.

identity_constraints: Never change the subject's shape, proportions, part count or construction.
Never change the subject's colours, materials, finish or surface pattern.
Never alter, move, redraw or invent logos, labels or printed text on the subject.
Never show a feature, accessory, variant or certification the real subject does not have.
Scale must agree with verified dimensions when the scene gives a size cue.

mockups.name: lifestyle
mockups.purpose: the subject in use, in context

style.background: A real, lightly styled environment that suits the subject.
